speech.heard: Mozambique has 0.2% of adults with a master's degree. Georgia has 24.9%. Mozambique is the world's lowest. Very few adults reach this level of study. Global giants are often lower. China has 0.9%, while Japan has 2.5%. The USA has 15%. This counts everyone aged 25 and over who attained or completed a master's or equivalent degree. The leaderboard climbs through Poland at 21.4%, Estonia at 21.8%, and Slovakia at 22.3%. Georgia is among the highest at 24.9%. That is 10 times the rate in Japan. How many adults hold a master's degree where you live?
